build_foldable_representation: build a foldable representation of a Python object using the default Treescope renderer and expansion strategy
render_to_text: render a Python object to a text representation using the default Treescope renderer
render_to_html: render a Python object to compressed HTML source code using the default Treescope renderer
using_expansion_strategy: use a context manager to configure balanced layout expansion with max height and target width constraints
configure_active_renderer: configure the default Treescope renderer with custom handlers, wrapper hooks, and context builders
